about_the_game:
Mongolian Death Worm. It is the ultimate UMA, with a perfect balance of form, ecology, and name. I arrived in the land of Mongolia to capture the Mongolian Death Worm. However, Mongolia has turned into a magical city with an army and an infestation of UMAs! To capture my beloved Mongolian Death Worm and save our Mongolian Death Worm Capture Department from extinction.

Now, the battle for the survival of the planet begins. ━━━━━━

◆Game Introduction◆

・This is a text adventure in the form of a visual novel game.

・There is no branching by choices, and there is one ending.

・The estimated playing time is about 1 hour.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following elements

Cartoon violence/fantasy violence

Combat without gore or bloodshed; display of weapons; bones/skeletons; derogatory language; anguish
Representations of graphic violence

Blood; violent acts; accidental death; bodily injury; corpses; descriptions of violence

Killing of a human being
Extremely violent or gore descriptive (e.g., body mutilation; torture; detailed depictions of death)

Glorification/instigation of violence

Realistic excessive/unjustified violence; grotesque violence
Suicide

Depiction of suicide
Crime

Depiction of criminal acts

Favorable portrayal of criminal acts
Fear

Fear - setting is dark but not realistic

Very frightening scenes; psychological fear
Language

Mild profanity, slurs, abusive language
